additional_info.subject: Re: ID0431580-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / PD 170001301] Charging Issue CRM:02889000117
additional_info.body:
Dear RC-FR Team,
The customer had reported an issue with the charger delivering lower power. This has now been resolved by updating the DC outlet power limits configuration via the SCB.
However, we’ve observed a persistent issue with one of the power converters showing a "CanCommLoss" error.
We recommend the following steps for troubleshooting this issue:
Please verify that the CAN cables are securely connected and not loose.
Next, swap the affected converter with a known working one.
If the error remains with the same converter, please proceed with replacing it.
If the error shifts to the working converter, the issue likely lies with the CAN cables, which should then be replaced.
For further guidance, you may also refer to the KA linked below as well:
KA Link:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_PowerConverter_ CanCommLoss error - Dynamics 365
